title: MoE neural-operator bank compressed by Mirror views
hypothesis: A shared spectral operator basis with per-regime View codes reduces a routed operator expert bank's complete bytes while preserving routed solution quality; top-2 views are useful only if their error gain justifies doubled active operator compute.
mirror_coordinate: regime coefficient code and top-k expert route

development.selection_metric: held-out total/high-band solution nRMSE, full serialized bank bytes, active operator multiplications

fresh.reason: no audit after exact native shared-basis alias

storage.authority: actual serialized complete inference payload bytes

success_gate: Total and high-band solution nRMSE <=.02; >=25% bytes saved versus independent full experts; strict quality/byte improvement over native shared-basis control. Top-2 must report its doubled active work.
failure_gate: Quality/storage miss, exact native function/payload alias, or top-2 quality gain with compute cost that loses the Pareto comparison is FAIL for Mirror-specific value.
boundaries: Regime router is an oracle metadata lookup, not a learned router.
No trained FNO, PDE validation, fresh audit or accelerator serving claim.
